services.name: Parasailing Muskoka
services.desc: Soar high above the lake and discover the incredible freedom of flight. As you gently ascend into the sky, breathtaking panoramic views and the peaceful sensation of floating hundreds of feet above the water create an experience you'll never forget. Our state-of-the-art parasail boats feature the latest hydraulic winch technology, allowing for smooth, effortless takeoffs and landings directly from the boat. No jumping, no running-just sit back, relax, and let the adventure begin. You'll be lifted gracefully into the air, where stunning scenery and pure exhilaration await. explain.meaning: Three people fly together under one parasail.

services.name: Flyboard & Jetovator
services.desc: Experience the thrills of flying over a jetstream of propulsion! Jetovator - Ride The Hose!You don’t have to be a water sports pro to try hydroflight. We provide the coaching and instructional experience to get you flying. Most people are successful within the first 10 minutes! We gradually build your skills and confidence to fly higher or even learn basic tricks during your session. Our strategy is usually to suggest the Jetovator first, then try the flyboard next. Reserve well in advance. Choose to combine your experience using both devices or all of your time perfecting one. PLEASE NOTE: YOU MUST KNOW HOW TO SWIM AND TREAD WATER CONFIDENTLY IN ORDER TO PARTICIPATE IN THIS ACTIVITY.

quotes.text: My family went parasailing with Craig & Tanner & it was a phenomenal experience. Craig explained everything clearly and carefully. He made sure we understood and we’re comfortable flying with him. We had three flights! Everyone loved the experience. I was so impressed with Craig’s skill & dedication and also with Tanner’s thorough and careful care.The family had a great time. Highly recommend!

Stopped in yesterday and asked if they had time to take us water skiing. Our sons had never water skied before and it had been over 30 years since I last did. Spencer was great. Gave me some great refresher points and away we went. Spent extra time with our boys and gave great instruction to give them an excellent experience. They had a great time. It brought back great memories for me and now we have a new great memory for our family. We also realized that 2 years previous, Spencer's dad had taken us up parasailing. Also an awesome experience. Thanks!!!
